items.description: The bulletin, in read order: one entry per fact worth voicing, each carrying one finished spoken sentence. The fitter may drop whole entries but never reorders them.

evidenceIds.description: The bracketed evidence ids this sentence asserts, exactly as supplied. Every road NAMED in the sentence must have its ids cited here. Never the group heading above them.
